definitions.explanation: A chemical product for cleaning — removing dirt, grease, or grime from surfaces, machinery, tableware, or the body. Made of {洗浄|せんじょう} (washing, cleansing) + {剤|ざい} (agent, preparation).

examples.japanese: ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{油汚|あぶらよご}れ→油汚れ：30381_aburayogore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This cleaner is tough on grease stains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}する→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Medical instruments are disinfected with a dedicated cleaning agent.

notes:
⟦{洗浄|せんじょう}→洗浄：28525_senjou⟧ (washing, cleansing) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, preparation). A general term for products used to clean surfaces and objects; more clinical or technical in tone than the everyday ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}: toilet cleaner
- ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}: dishwashing agent
- {洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a cleaning agent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧: detergent — the everyday household word (laundry, dishes)
